fufu 0.17.0 wires three more agent clients — OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Qwen Code — and moves the Codex and Cursor installs onto each client's native plugin. Gemini CLI's adapter is gone.

## New clients

[`ff hook opencode`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/opencode/) writes one plugin module fufu owns whole, with the skill beside it. It captures before every tool call and puts the briefing in the system prompt of every model call, so it survives compaction. A `fufu.js` fufu did not write is reported as hand-written and left alone.

[`ff hook copilot`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/copilot/) writes an Agent Plugins 1.0 plugin under `~/.agents/plugins/copilot/`, an entry in the marketplace beside it, and a registration in `~/.copilot/settings.json`. Copilot loads it live; the next session captures and is briefed.

[`ff hook qwen`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/qwen/) merges five hook events into `~/.qwen/settings.json`. It ships no skill.

A shell verb under any of these, or under Codex or Cursor, carries the client's session the way it already did under Claude Code.

## Codex and Cursor as plugins

[`ff hook codex`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/codex/) writes a plugin at `~/.agents/plugins/fufu/` with the skill inside, merges an entry into the personal marketplace, and runs `codex plugin add` when `codex` is on `PATH`. Codex gains `SessionStart`, `Stop`, and `SessionEnd`. Once the plugin verifies, the install strips what an earlier fufu wrote under `~/.codex/`, and [`ff unhook codex`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/unhook/) no longer opens `~/.codex/config.toml`. Codex still trusts a hook by its hash: run `/hooks` there and approve fufu's, or nothing captures.

[`ff hook cursor`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/cursor/) writes a user-local plugin at `~/.cursor/plugins/local/fufu/`, which Cursor CLI discovers on a new session. An install an earlier fufu merged into `~/.cursor/hooks.json` reads as wired and stale; `ff hook -u` migrates it. `beforeSubmitPrompt` and `stop` are not wired, as Cursor CLI gates them on user settings, and cloud agents get no user-local hooks.

## Removed

`ff hook gemini` and `ff unhook gemini` are gone; Gemini CLI's hook names diverged from the family. `ff trigger gemini` still serves entries an earlier fufu wrote.

[`ff commit`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/commit/) no longer prints a `re-minted:` line or carries `reminted` in `--json`. With signing on, the `@` row shows the open commit's sha and the close lands a different one, as it does for a partial close or a message set on the command line.

## Fixes

[`ff hook claude`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/hooks/claude/) on Windows wrote the binary's path unquoted, and Git Bash collapsed the backslashes, so every wired event failed while `ff hook -l` still said wired. The path is quoted now; `ff hook claude` or `ff hook -u` rewrites an existing install.

## Miscellaneous

- `hook/failed` names a client file or plugin directory that could not be written or did not read back; `hook/malformed` names a client file that is not the JSON object its client reads. Both leave the file untouched.
- `ff hook -l --json` reports an unreadable client file as `unavailable` with its complaint, and a hand-written file as `hand-written`.
